title: Relatives protest outside Plovdiv clinic over child's death

tea.why: Relatives and friends are protesting following court decisions regarding the death of a six-year-old child after a dental procedure.
tea.want: Demonstrators are demanding a verdict and punishment for the doctors involved in the case.
tea.changed: Nov 15: Relatives of the deceased child called for a protest outside the Medicus Alpha clinic in Plovdiv.

summary: Relatives and friends of a six-year-old boy who died following a dental procedure under general anesthesia have organised a protest outside the Medicus Alpha clinic in Plovdiv. The demonstration, called through social media under the banner 'Justice for Angel', follows a court hearing on November 9 where the indictment was returned to the prosecutor's office, as well as a recent Supreme Administrative Court ruling allowing the hospital to continue operating pending a decision on the health minister's order to revoke its license. The criminal case involves two anesthesiologists and a dentist facing charges related to the child's death in April 2025. No official response from the clinic or authorities regarding the demonstration itself is reported in the sources.
demands: Verdict and punishment for the doctors involved
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Relatives and friends scheduled a protest outside the Medicus Alpha clinic starting at noon.
